svg.title: The denominators are nonzero real constants. Polynomial interpolation modulo the annihilating polynomials gives q = P a1,...,an wa1,...,an and Diwa1,...,an = λaiwa1,...,an. These are finite algebraic operations, with no bounded-operator spectral theorem assumed for Di on this growth space. Read- out preserves every component and its growth restriction. For an eigenwave TR28 gives the exact parcel ratio 4|λai|2 = 22ai. If ai = 0, decreasing only its radius to zero leaves the parcel mass constant; finite-measure continuity identifies it with the zero mass of ki = 0.
